notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (54.47722, -109.3775) match the websiteservice list (54-28.6333 N, 109-22.6500 W); no correction. Wikipedia gives the lake's centre point at 54.433425, -109.417464, about 5 km from the listed tower point; no source places the tower on the shore. Record agency is unconfirmed, the same issue as Kingsmere (see that file). Two WebSearch calls returned no page describing this tower; the only Lac des Iles results were a Quebec place name and a Quebec wildfire record, which are unrelated. Not checked: Saskatchewan Archives reports, and the Meadow Lake Provincial Park or Meadow Lake museum records.
